model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between Co-occurrence Number and ACC (%) for various methods. The x-axis, labeled "Co-occurrence Number," has a logarithmic scale, ranging from $10^1$ to $10^3$, with no units provided. The y-axis, labeled "ACC(%)", has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 65. The plot features six lines, each representing a different method: Base (black, solid, circle markers), FT (blue, solid, triangle markers), IKE (red, solid, triangle markers), MEND (brown, dashed, triangle markers), MEMIT (purple, solid, diamond markers), and ROME (green, solid, square markers). The Base line starts at approximately 5 and decreases to around 2 as the Co-occurrence Number increases from $10^1$ to $10^3$. The FT line starts at around 15 and decreases to approximately 10 over the same range. The IKE line begins at about 30 and decreases to around 20. The MEND line starts at approximately 38 and decreases to around 28. The MEMIT line begins at around 40 and decreases to approximately 32. The ROME line starts at about 47 and decreases to around 42.
